description: A crescent prism one high, its two top arcs chamfered at 0.1 so that the stripes meet on their own section from the top's contact (-1.7, -0.8485, 1) down to the spine at (-2, 0, 0.9) (the mutual trim, ADR-0084), the cusp vertex gone. A box [-2.5, -0.7, 0.92]-[-1.75, 0.2, 2] cut from it: its planes z = 0.92 and y = -0.7 cross both stripes and the section edge, which the cut shortens to the part outside the box. The section edge is the cone/cone (or torus/torus) section fitted within SECTION_FIT_FRACTION of the linear tolerance, 2.5e-8 (ADR-0042, ADR-0062); where the cut puts a vertex on it that error no longer cancels between the two faces, so the fixture's volume and inertia are held at 5e-9, not the default 1e-9. A 20-digit quadrature of the chamfered height field gives the exact volume, 4.66989739705: Open CASCADE is 3e-11 off it and Arris's body 1.2e-9 in memory and 5.1e-9 as Open CASCADE reads Arris's STEP.
